description: This is a Java source file defining the KafkaClientActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing Kafka connections, publishers, and connection states within the Ditto project.

classes.name: KafkaClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing Kafka client connections, publishers, and connection state transitions.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the configuration object for instantiating KafkaClientActor with given connection parameters and factory.

methods.name: validateConnection
methods.description: Validates or processes the connection object during actor creation.

methods.name: inTestingState
methods.description: Defines handling of different events when the actor is in the testing state, such as status reports, connection success, or failure.

methods.name: inConnectingState
methods.description: Defines handling of events during the connecting state, primarily status reports.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Initiates a test connection process, returning the status outcome asynchronously.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Handles establishing a connection to Kafka with the provided connection details.

methods.name: getPublisherActor
methods.description: Returns the current Kafka publisher actor reference.

methods.name: connectClient
methods.description: Starts Kafka publisher actors and manages the connection process.

methods.name: startKafkaPublisher
methods.description: Initializes and starts a Kafka publisher actor.

methods.name: stopPublisherActor
methods.description: Gracefully stops the Kafka publisher actor if it exists.

methods.name: handleStatusReportFromChildren
methods.description: Handles status reports from child actors, updating pending reports, and proceeding to connect if all are ready.

methods.name: completeTestConnectionFuture
methods.description: Completes the future representing the test connection result, with success or failure.
